sentences.en: The audience was immersed in an aftertaste of the concert.
sentences.zh: 观众沉浸在音乐会留下的余韵中。

sentences.en: There must have been a large audience at the concert.
sentences.zh: 这场音乐会上一定有很多观众。

sentences.en: The lecturer couldn't get his message across to the audience.
sentences.zh: 演讲者无法让在场的听众理解他的信息。
